we present a CNN-FVC method for image classification by exploiting activations of a pre-trained CNN.
we propose a CNN based Fisher Vector Coding method for image classification.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to efficiently model the complex distribution for image classification with CNN-based region features, and how to effectively fuse the region features from CNN-based Fisher vector and GMM-FVC.
the design of a CNN based Fisher Vector Coding method for image classification.
the design and implementation of a novel CNN-based Fisher vector image classifier, which can achieve state-of-the-art classification accuracy and efficiency on the standard image benchmarks.

the proposed CNN-FVC method is a powerful image classification tool that can be used in conjunction with other GMM-FVC based methods.
the proposed method is a novel and effective Fisher vector coding method for image classification.

our method is able to achieve state-of-the-art classification performance on two standard scene classification benchmarks, and the proposed method is complementary to previous GMM based Fisher vector coding methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed CNN-FVC can be viewed as a general framework for image classification.
CNN-FVC is a simple and efficient Fisher vector coding method which is complementary to the GMM-FVC approach.
the proposed CNN-FVC approach is able to improve the performance of Fisher vector coding methods by exploiting the discriminative power of pre-trained CNNs.

the Fisher vector coding method is not only applicable for CNN activations, but can also be extended to other types of discriminative models.
